Messages.Author: Szewski
Messages.Body:
Gargoyle creature with 4 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
Rock Cat may enter combat with a ready minion as a  action. Opposing vampires with capacity 3 or less cannot strike in the first round. Rock Cat gets an optional press each combat. Rock Cat may play cards requiring basic Potence Potence as a 3-capacity vampire.

Since the rockC in combat is threaten like a 3-cap vampire, does he gets the bonus from torn signpost?

(Vampires have +strenght but allies hav x strenght correct?)

THX

regards
Szewski

Messages.Author: blackday
Messages.Body: As i understood it no, you would actually make its strength weaker to 2 strength as u would be forced to play inf pot.

Messages.Author: blackday
Messages.Body: If you want a bonus to strength it would be fists of death, but of course it would cost 1 blood/life. Maybe inc strength then play a potence strike card.

Messages.Author: Ohlmann
Messages.Body:
Well, before playing inc strength, first play some undead strength.

But really, what the rock cat need most tend to be Immortal Grapple or ranged damage (throw sewer lid). Hitting for 6 (with the press) is often enough.

(it's a shame that Rock cat cannot play Raking Talon)

Messages.Author: Pascal Bertrand
Messages.Body:

> Gargoyle creature with 4 life. 3 strength, 0 bleed.
> Rock Cat may enter combat with a ready minion as a  action. Opposing vampires with capacity 3 or less cannot strike in the first round. Rock Cat gets an optional press each combat. Rock Cat may play cards requiring basic Potence Potence as a 3-capacity vampire.
>
> Since the rockC in combat is threaten like a 3-cap vampire, does he gets the bonus from torn signpost?
>
> (Vampires have +strenght but allies hav x strenght correct?)
>
> THX
>
> regards
> Szewski
>
Vampires and allies have a default strength.
Rulebook 6.4.5  wrote:
>
> Minions have a default strength of 1.
>
Rock Cat's default strength is overriden by its cardtext : "3 strength".
If Rock Cat plays a Torn Signpost, Rock Cat has 2 strength (instead of 3).

Messages.Author: Ankha
Messages.Body:
And a Great Beast would also have a reduced strength, so whether the minion is a vampire or not is irrelevant.

> Name: Call the Great Beast
> Cardtype: Action
> Clan: Baali
> Cost: 1 blood
> +1 stealth action.
> Put this card on the acting Baali and put X ritual counters on it, where X is the capacity of this Baali. This Baali may put a ritual counter on this card as a +1 stealth action. When this card has more than 10 ritual counters, burn this Baali and choose three Disciplines. This card becomes a unique clanless independent infernal vampire with 9 capacity, 4 strength and 3 bleed. The Great Beast has the chosen three Disciplines at superior. Move 9 blood to him from the blood bank. The Great Beast can enter combat with any ready minion controlled by another Methuselah as a  action and can prevent 1 damage each combat.
